name: Stone Oracle
theme: An ancient Nordic rune-seer who draws wisdom from sacred stones, shaping protective wards, binding threats, and revealing hidden truths through earthbound prophecy.
visualIdentity: Earth-toned oracle robes, carved runestone staff, stone talismans, layered furs, weathered leather bindings, engraved runes, and restrained amber and stone-gray magical effects.
consistency: Use the same face, hairstyle, robe silhouette, runestone staff design, rune carvings, talisman placement, leather bindings, and earth-tone palette across all assets.

starterAbilities.name: Stone Ward
starterAbilities.description: Create a protective rune barrier that shields allies.

starterAbilities.name: Earthshackle
starterAbilities.description: Bind enemies with earthen runes that hinder movement.

starterAbilities.name: Oracle's Revelation
starterAbilities.description: Reveal hidden threats and gain prophetic insight.
